cohort: The study included placentas and fetal organs from an autopsy cohort (fetal deaths due to MVM vs. stillborn controls) and placentas and umbilical cord blood from a liveborn population with and without MVM.
finding: The study found decreased alpha-klotho (AK) gene and protein expression in placentas exposed to MVM, and lower placental AK expression was associated with increased odds of preterm birth in liveborn infants.
cross-section timing: At birth for liveborn infants and post-mortem for autopsy cases.
